capabilities: Opens script files and known dotfiles as read-only source
Shows stable line numbers with a soft-wrap toggle
Builds outlines of functions, labels, hotkeys and config keys
Highlights comments, strings, variables and risky command patterns
Searches source lines and filters outline items
disambiguation: Not a script runner or terminal; it only displays script source read-only.
extras: Read-only by design: it never executes scripts, starts terminals, mutates files, reads the clipboard or makes network requests. Rendering is capped at 10,000 lines, and parsing uses local heuristics rather than full language parsers. Installation is described only as manual download of main.js, manifest.json and styles.css.
intentEvidence: Script Viewer is intentionally narrower. It focuses on risky automation artifacts
motivation: Script files can delete data, alter system settings, call remote endpoints, or launch other programs, so the plugin is built for inspection only.
problem: Script files and dotfiles in a vault have no built-in read-only viewer, so they fall through to external apps or do not open at all.

relations.evidence: Code View provides broad read-only syntax highlighting for many languages.
Code Files is editor-first and Monaco-based.
Code Space is a broader code workspace.

summary: Read-only viewer that opens shell, batch, PowerShell, AutoHotkey and dotfile sources with line numbers, outline, search and safety hints.
